title: chytroma gigantea
intro: Chytroma gigantea, commonly known as Bearberry, is a low-growing, evergreen shrub native to Europe, Asia, and North America. Bearberry has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as its antiseptic and astringent properties, which help in treating urinary tract infections and diarrhea. The therapeutic actions of Bearberry include acting as a diuretic, antipyretic, and anti-inflammatory, making it an effective remedy for fever reduction and inflammation management. The bioactive constituents of Bearberry include arbutin, ursolic acid, and scopoletin, which contribute to its medicinal properties and therapeutic actions.
